_comment: train_frac/val_frac CHANGED 2026-08-30 (0.8/0.1 -> 0.2/0.0): weights already exist on disk (never trained by this harness), so train_split() only ever fed _build_cv_reference()'s luminance histogram, which is internally capped at ~1000 samples regardless of input size -- the old 80% allocation (~2058 images) was mostly wasted. val_split() has zero consumers anywhere in experiments/run_experiment.py's actual per-run pipeline (only experiments/calibrate_drift_threshold.py, a separate script, reads it) -- dropped to 0.0 entirely. Frees ~80% of the trimmed manifest for the stream instead of ~10%.
